description: Decode PEM/DER X.509 certificates, chains and CSRs offline: subject/issuer DN, serial, validity and days left, SANs, key type/size/curve, signature algorithm, key usage / EKU / basic constraints, AKI/SKI, OCSP / CA-issuer / CRL URLs, policies and embedded SCT count, SHA-1/SHA-256 fingerprints and SPKI pin; verifies each chain link signature and order, flags self-signed, expired / expiring, weak keys, SHA-1 signatures and over-long lifetimes, and checks hostname coverage (RFC 6125 wildcards). Private keys are refused. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/x509-decode

hostname.description: Optional hostname / IP to check against the leaf SANs

pem.description: One or more PEM certificates (leaf first) and/or a CSR, or base64 DER
